definition.text_en: Gaius; a believer associated with Paul and John.
definition.text_es: Gayo; creyente asociado con Pablo y Juan.

decisions.reason: Greek proper name in Delitzsch text; existing D0057 custom entry already represents Gaius and should be used instead of the unrelated Hebrew H7291 lookup.
evidence: Existing custom entry D0057 is the project proper-name entry for גיוס / Gaius.

decisions.reason: Epistle opening names Paul; existing D0024 custom entry already represents פּוֹלוֹס / Paul and should be used instead of the unrelated Hebrew H336 lookup.
evidence: Ephesians 1:1 opens with Paul as the sender.
Existing custom entry D0024 is the project proper-name entry for פּוֹלוֹס / Paul.
